data.description: A mesmerist wearing this mask increases the range of his hypnotic stare ability by 10 feet as the mask allows him to better focus on his targets. Creatures under the effects of the wearer's hypnotic stare take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls against the wearer.
data.name: Mask of the Mesmerist
